## PENDING CARE SETTING CONSOLIDATION
This page is pending SME review to merge inpatient/outpatient/ER-UC guidance into a single combined recommendation. Until that review is complete, each care setting's original content is shown separately below.

# INITIAL EMPIRIC ANTIBIOTIC GUIDELINES FOR SEPSIS:

Empirical antimicrobial choice for sepsis is based on coverage of pathogens that

typically cause the source infection. Please choose the suspected source

infection below to view recommendations.

[Unclear Infectious Source](sepsis-empiric-therapy-site-unk)

[Pneumonia](sepsis-pneumonia)

[Meningitis, CNS Infection](orzid2-gmenu-sepsis-suspected-meningitis)

[Endocarditis](sepsis-susp-endocarditis)

[Necrotizing Infection](necrotizing-infections)

[Skin Soft Tissue Infection](sepsis-suspected-skin-soft-tissue)

[Urinary Tract Infection \(AKA urosepsis\)](orzid2-gmenu-sepsis-suspected-uro-sepsis)

[Intraabdominal Infection](sepsis-empiric-therapy-site-unk)

[Clostridium Difficile Infection](sepsis-susp-c-difficile)
